suite: Readable stale storage with rejected writes — production closure regressions

checks.name: post office restores the latest three items after an age/range round trip when only writes fail
art restores latest free PNG and per-template coloring when old storage reads succeed but writes fail

limits: Node VM with controlled localStorage behavior; no actual browser quota, private-mode, or device validation.
Memory protects progress within the same loaded page; a real reload cannot recover writes the browser rejected.
